description: LAUNCHING SOON: answers 503 until event discovery goes live. One Luma or Partiful event's speakers, sponsors, agenda and side events, from its URL or an `events_search` id. Each section has a `status`: ok (items found), not_published (the page publishes none, with a reason) or unreadable (could not tell); an empty list never means none on its own. Items parsed from the description carry `source: description`, the heading they sat under and a `confidence`. Costs $0.005 only when at least one section is ok; everything else is free. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

id.description: An event id from `events_search`, such as `luma.evt-AbC123`.

url.description: A Luma (luma.com/<slug>, lu.ma/<slug>) or Partiful (partiful.com/e/<id>) event page. Give url or id, not both.
